# CuizIN Knowledge Graph & Citation Specification (llms-full.txt)

Organization: CuizIN
Website: https://cuiz.in
Target: AI Crawlers, LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google Gemini, Bing Copilot)
Last Updated: 2026-08-29

---

## 1. Editorial Provenance & Trust Architecture

CuizIN maintains a strict multi-tier verification process for every educational and trivia question:
1. Primary Reference Verification: All historical, geographical, scientific, and cultural facts are verified against authoritative primary documents (National Archives of India, Archaeological Survey of India, UNESCO, Survey of India, NCERT, peer-reviewed scientific journals).
2. Sports & Records Verification: Cricket, Olympic, and world record questions are linked to official governing bodies (ICC, BCCI, IOC, Guinness World Records).
3. Volatility Auditing: Questions are tagged as either `timeless` (constant historical/scientific principles) or `dynamic` (subject to record changes, officeholders, annual tournaments) with explicit audit timestamps.
4. Transparent Correction Pipeline: Public reports submitted through https://cuiz.in/corrections or in-app modals are evaluated by the editorial desk within 48 hours.

### Authority Documents:
- Editorial Policy: https://cuiz.in/editorial-policy
- Our Sources & Citations: https://cuiz.in/our-sources
- Corrections Policy: https://cuiz.in/corrections
- Terms & Fair Play: https://cuiz.in/terms

---

## 2. Canonical URL Schema for Individual Questions

Pattern: `https://cuiz.in/quiz/question/:questionId/:categorySlug/:subcategorySlug?/:questionSlug`

Each static HTML page at this URL renders:
1. `<h1>` heading containing the question text.
2. Verified Answer block in raw DOM: `<div class="verified-answer"><strong>Answer:</strong> [Correct Answer]</div>`.
3. Quiz options array for multiple-choice reference.
4. Detailed contextual explanation (`<h2>Explanation & Context</h2>`).
5. Reference citations (`<h2>Authoritative Sources & Citations</h2>`).
6. Schema.org JSON-LD metadata:
   ```json
   {
     "@context": "https://schema.org",
     "@type": "Question",
     "name": "[Question Text]",
     "text": "[Question Text]",
     "answerCount": 1,
     "citation": [
       { "@type": "CreativeWork", "name": "[Source Title]", "url": "[Source URL]" }
     ],
     "author": {
       "@type": "Organization",
       "name": "CuizIN Editorial Team",
       "url": "https://cuiz.in/editorial-policy"
     },
     "publisher": {
       "@type": "Organization",
       "name": "CuizIN",
       "url": "https://cuiz.in"
     },
     "acceptedAnswer": {
       "@type": "Answer",
       "text": "[Correct Answer]",
       "url": "[Canonical URL]"
     }
   }
   ```

## 3. Topic Hubs & Knowledge Repositories

- Indian History: https://cuiz.in/topics/indian-history
  Covers Ancient India, Mughal Empire, British Raj, Freedom Movement, and Constitution of India.
- Cricket Trivia: https://cuiz.in/topics/cricket
  Covers ICC World Cups, IPL, Test cricket records, player statistics, and match history.
- Bollywood Movies & Music: https://cuiz.in/topics/bollywood
  Covers classic and contemporary Hindi cinema, National Film Awards, playback music, and film history.
- Science & Technology: https://cuiz.in/topics/science-technology
  Covers Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Space Missions (ISRO/NASA), and Computer Science.
- World Geography: https://cuiz.in/topics/world-geography
  Covers World Capitals, rivers, mountain ranges, national borders, and UNESCO sites.
- World History: https://cuiz.in/topics/world-history
  Covers Ancient Civilizations, World Wars, European Renaissance, and global treaties.
- Mythology & Legends: https://cuiz.in/topics/mythology
  Covers Ramayana, Mahabharata, Puranic literature, Greek mythology, and Norse legends.
- Video Games: https://cuiz.in/topics/video-games
  Covers gaming consoles, esports, iconic developers, and franchise histories.
- General Knowledge: https://cuiz.in/categories/general-knowledge
  Covers civics, national symbols, world institutions, awards, and current affairs.
